english.title: Cause use of vehicle with swivelling lamp / reflector
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), caused **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to use on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),

(A)_[to which]_
(B)_[to the load of which]_
(C)_[to the equipment of which]_

was fitted a

(D)_[lamp]_
(E)_[reflector]_
(F)_[marking]_

which was capable of being moved by swivelling, deflecting or otherwise while the vehicle was in motion
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 12(1) of the Road Vehicles Lighting Regulations 1989, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
caused the use on a road of a vehicle fitted with a lamp/reflector/marking capable of being
swivelled/deflected/otherwise moved while the vehicle is in motion

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale (level four if goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers).

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
